title: Network lab 1: Your first network
intro: Banyan Books front office: cable four computers to a switch, give them addresses, and prove with ping which can talk and why one cannot.

tasks.text: Cable all four computers to the switch
tasks.hint: Design mode: choose Cable, click a computer, then click the switch.

tasks.text: Give till-1, till-2 and office the addresses in the plan (192.168.1.11, .12 and .13, mask 255.255.255.0)
tasks.hint: Design mode: click a computer and fill in its panel on the right.

tasks.text: Give stray 192.168.2.14, then ping till-2 and office from till-1
tasks.hint: Press Simulation, click till-1, open Command line and type ping 192.168.1.12.

tasks.text: Ping stray (192.168.2.14) from till-1 and see why it fails
tasks.hint: stray is in network 192.168.2, a different network from the other three.

tasks.text: Fix stray's address (192.168.1.14) and ping it from till-1
tasks.hint: Back in Design mode, change the address in stray's panel, then ping it again from till-1 in Simulation mode.
